notes.title: Dear community!!!
notes.content:
Dear community,

Greetings! As a small team of indie developers, we are thrilled to announce the release of our first game on Steam. Initially, we aimed for an early access launch, but adjustments in our development schedule and Steam regulations have led us to opt for a full release instead. To ensure a robust post-launch experience, we'll spend the next two weeks adding the latest features and fixes. In gratitude to our early supporters, we're offering a special discount for first-time buyers.

Our project's technical complexity and diversity have made it a challenging yet rewarding endeavor. Inspired by our passion for racing games and RC cars, we've invested considerable effort in perfecting the game's physics and environment. Despite our ambitions, the looming release deadline means some envisioned features won't make the cut.

We invite you to support our dedicated team, who have committed to ongoing updates and mods. Join our Discord community to share your feedback and suggestions, helping us refine and enhance the game. Your input is invaluable, and we are committed to considering your ideas for its future development.

Let's collaborate to overcome any challenges and make our game the best it can be.

If you're hesitant to purchase immediately, we invite you to revisit in a week. Our team updates the game daily, promising an array of exciting features shortly. Your presence in our community is appreciated, regardless of immediate purchase intent.

Thank you for your understanding, support, and enthusiasm.
Thank you for being a part of our journey.
https://discord.gg/8GFFjmXJPC

Our roadmap for the coming weeks:


Game Modes
-Crawler mode.
-Time Attack
-POI
-Stunt
-Boosters
-Boss Fight

Multiplayer modes:
[Arena] Rocket Ball
Kick Off
[Bomberman
[Arena] King of the hill


Tournaments
-By type of car (Chassis)
-By surface type (asphalt, offroad, carpet, mixed)
-Internal division into cars by pumping, by spare parts grade.
-Drift
-Stunt
-Time Attack
-Survival (HP)
-Survival on a large number of ovals.
-LOCATION Tournament: drive all the tracks at one location. 
Prizes - money, prospect points and cosmetics

notes.title: Rev up your engines: unveiling cars and customization in RC REVOLuTion!
notes.content:
One of the questions we've been receiving is:

[i]New cars? Any chance there are going to be new cars or new ways to change up how the cars look?[/i]

Well, buckle up, because we're about to delve into the fantastic world of RC car customization and new additions!

[h2]Two Leagues, Two Experiences[/h2]

Our game features two leagues that cater to different types of players.

[b]Amateur League[/b]: For those who just want to hop in and race without any fuss. This league features non-disassemblable cars in boxes, using arcade physics. It's all about straightforward fun and speed. The current demo on Steam offers a taste of the Amateur League, and we're working on adding the ability to change the cars' paint jobs.

[b]Professional League[/b]: This is where things get really interesting. The cars in this league consist of separate modules, built upon one of four main bases. The customization possibilities here are almost endless!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952165/bca244c2d53530c0ef60a913ad20f65587ee3e14.png[/img]

[h2]Details Make the Difference[/h2]

We're making an exciting, arcade-style racing game, but we want it to have depth, too. We're looking at real RC cars and understanding how they work, right down to the smallest gear. This allows us to create an immersive experience that RC fans will find intriguing and satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952165/0b1960938b07e83f5744f3f0fe5092d88150c763.png[/img]

Of course, we're not trying to make a hyper-realistic simulator—that's not our goal. We want to keep the game fun and diverse, which means accepting certain game conventions and balancing realism with playability.

[h2]A Deeper Look at the Pro League Customization[/h2]

In the Pro League, customization is king. We're considering how different parts will fit together, allowing players to truly create the car of their dreams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952165/71beae1f811cbcc64ec3714eb286a8bba39311a7.png[/img]

For instance, look at this RC type BUGGY base. When we tried fitting a battery model, we realized that only the simplest and cheapest battery fits into this variant. This means we need to modify the layout of parts or the shape of the base itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952165/3eb08742771d7d723588aeb6440506e2c7f9dc43.png[/img]

Experimentation is part of the process. We're constantly trying out new external cases and models, always aiming for diversity.

[h2]Customization UI and More[/h2]

Finally, take a look at our UI prototype for customization. Soon, you'll have the chance to try changing skins for the cars in our demo, taking personalization to a whole new level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952165/268de6ff6c0bf88babb592c712be448a5debe3a2.png[/img]

This is just a brief overview in response to your questions from the Steam community. We're always eager to share more about our development process and future plans, so don't hesitate to ask more questions. We'll do our best to answer them as fully as possible.

Stay tuned for more updates and keep those engines revving!

notes.title: New demo is available now!
notes.content:
Hello, RC REVOLuTion Community!

We've always been a team of doers more than talkers. Our keyboards have been clattering and our screens glowing as we've poured our hearts and souls into creating an RC racing game that we hope will bring joy, excitement, and maybe a little bit of nostalgia to all of you.

We've been a bit shy about sharing our progress, preferring to let our work speak for itself. But today, we're stepping out from the shadows and into the light, ready to share our journey with our community.

We're thrilled to announce that we're releasing a new demo of RC REVOLuTion! This demo is a culmination of countless hours of hard work, tweaking, testing, and refining. We've been listening to your feedback and we believe that this new demo will not only meet but exceed your expectations.

From here on, we're committed to keeping you in the loop. We'll be posting regular updates, sharing behind-the-scenes peeks, and asking for your thoughts and feedback. You're not just players to us; you're part of our team, part of this adventure we've embarked upon.

So, without further ado, start your engines, hit the download button, and dive into the new demo of RC REVOLuTion. We can't wait to hear what you think!

Fasten your seatbelts, because this is just the beginning. Stay tuned for more updates and exciting news as we continue to rev up our game development engines.

Until then, happy racing!

The RC REVOLuTion Team
